title: Source registry: Serbian facade-contractor data sources
method_notes: Every source below was opened over HTTP during this research pass. Counts labelled 'measured' come from parsing the fetched HTML/XML, not from what the site claims about itself.

Phone counting used the regex (\+381|00381|\b0)[0-9 /-]{7,13}[0-9] against the raw HTML, then de-duplicated after stripping separators. Image filenames occasionally produce false positives; every High-priority number below was spot-checked against rendered page text.
robots.txt was fetched directly for every source; the quoted rule is verbatim from the file on 2026-08-19.

Serbian queries were run in both diacritic and ASCII-folded form (fasader/fasaderi, gradjevinski/gradevinski, izrada fasade, termo fasada, demit fasada, termoizolacija, stiropor fasada, molersko fasaderski radovi, zavrsni gradjevinski radovi, majstori za fasadu).

Amended 2026-08-20 (FUZZ-28) to land two corrections measured by FUZZ-8: portal-srbija's city-scoped category pages are not strict subsets of the national page (+80% on the one category measured, with 14 city slugs deterministically 500ing including beograd), and the APR register is available as free open data at openapi.apr.gov.rs rather than only through a commercial licensing conversation. Where FUZZ-4 and FUZZ-8 disagree, the measured FUZZ-8 finding wins; the superseded FUZZ-4 text is kept inline so the change is auditable. Nothing else in this registry was re-measured on that date.

Amended 2026-08-21 (FUZZ-39): the `daibau` entry was re-measured end to end after FUZZ-39 was opened on the premise that its listing pages carry contractor phone numbers. They do not. The FUZZ-4 verdict (0% phone obtainable, do not scrape, Low) is confirmed; its record count (75), pagination reading (5 pages) and requires_js flag (true) are corrected to 748, walk-to-exhaustion and false respectively. Where FUZZ-4 and FUZZ-39 disagree on those three, the measured FUZZ-39 figure wins.

Amended 2026-08-21 (FUZZ-45): the kompanije-net entry researched by FUZZ-41 in research/sources-kompanije-net.json was merged into this registry when its adapter was built, and tos_forbids was recorded alongside robots_allows as FUZZ-44 established. FUZZ-41's figures are kept verbatim; everything labelled FUZZ-45 was measured by the adapter itself on a real sample run and is re-derivable with scripts/fuzz45-overlap.ts. Only sources_evaluated and high were changed in the summary block - the other counts are FUZZ-4's and were not re-derived.

Amended 2026-08-22 (FUZZ-45): the kompanije-net entry's estimates were replaced with measurements from the adapter's own 2,320-record sample run - phone fill, maticni broj / PIB fill, the dead-record rate against APR open data, the overlap against the existing corpus, and the adjacent-code verdict. Where FUZZ-41 and FUZZ-45 disagree, the measured FUZZ-45 figure wins; FUZZ-41's method notes are kept inline so the change is auditable. Every number is re-derivable with scripts/fuzz45-overlap.ts.

summary.raw_records_reachable_high_priority_meth: portal-srbija 642 + gradjevinarstvo.rs 11,291 + navidiku.rs 330 + gradjevinskefirme.cu.rs ~3,000 + poslovnikontakt 746 + 011info ~400. FUZZ-8 note: the portal-srbija 642 is a floor - its national category pages truncate, and a city-iterated sweep measured +80% on the one category tested, so this total understates by an unmeasured margin.
summary.estimated_facade_contractor_records_meth: Sector-wide sources are discounted by the facade/insulation/finishing share observed while sampling: gradjevinarstvo.rs 11,291 x ~10% = ~1,100; gradjevinskefirme.cu.rs 3,000 x ~11% = ~325; poslovnikontakt 746 -> ~50 in the two moler/fasader categories; 011info ~150 of ~400. Facade-scoped sources are taken as-is: portal-srbija 642, navidiku 330. Sum ~2,600 before cross-source dedup.
summary.estimated_unique_after_dedup_method: Applying a ~25-30% cross-source overlap allowance for Belgrade/Novi Sad firms that appear in more than one of the three sector-wide registers. This is an allowance, not a measurement - it should be replaced with a real number after the first dedup run.
summary.phone_bearing_share_expected: ~85-90% of the records above, given measured per-source phone coverage of ~100% (portal-srbija, navidiku, poslovnikontakt), ~90% (gradjevinarstvo.rs) and high-but-detail-page-only (gradjevinskefirme.cu.rs, 011info).
summary.apr_open_data_frame: 133,634 active privredna drustva from openapi.apr.gov.rs (FUZZ-8), of which 2,813 sit under the six core facade/building-material activity codes across 168 municipalities. Zero phones, so this is not part of the totals above - it is the denominator to measure them against, and the classification ground truth. Excludes preduzetnici entirely.

sources.name: Portal Srbija
sources.estimate_method: Fetched each facade-relevant category page and counted unique company detail links in the HTML: termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija=141, zavrsni-radovi-restauracije=156, hidroizolacija=135, za-gradjevinske-radove=94, ciscenje-fasada-skidanje-grafita=51, grubi-gradjevinski-radovi=32, proizvodnja-stiropora=26, sanacije-gradjevinskih-objekata=17, radovi-na-visini=16. Sum = 668 before cross-category overlap; ~642 after discounting ~4% duplicate slugs seen in more than one category. Sitemap index (sitemap1..8.xml) holds 64,818 unique slugs, of which 867 are category roots (a slug S is a category when S and S-beograd both exist). CORRECTED BY FUZZ-8: 642 is a FLOOR, not the total. The national category page truncates its listing, so the union over city-scoped pages is larger. Measured on termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija over 49 city URLs (the 32 most populous units plus all 17 Belgrade city municipalities from data/serbia-geo.json): national page alone 60 firms, union of national + city pages 108, i.e. 48 firms reachable only via a city page (+80% on one category). The true national total is unmeasured; re-derive it from a full city sweep.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: ~100% of listing rows; measured 195 unique phones across 141 companies on /termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija, 213 across 156 on /zavrsni-radovi-restauracije, 199 across 94 on /za-gradjevinske-radove (many firms list a landline plus a mobile). No mailto: links found on any category page - this source is phone-only.

pagination.how_addressed: No pagination at all. Every company in a category is rendered on one static page (e.g. /zavrsni-radovi-restauracije is 147 KB with all 156 firms). City-scoped subsets exist as <category>-<grad> (e.g. /termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija-beograd). CORRECTED BY FUZZ-8: these city pages are NOT strict subsets of the national page and the national page must NOT be crawled alone. Measured on termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija: 60 firms nationally vs a union of 108 over national + 49 city URLs, 48 of them found only on a city page (+80%). Nine of the twelve firms on the Novi Sad page (Izomonter, Termodom, Domino gradjevinski centar, Eko dom, Hit - promet, ...) are absent from the national page. Belgrade alone contributes 52 firms through its city municipalities, 26 of them new. The national page is the seed; city iteration is the enumeration.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://www.portal-srbija.com/robots.txt: "User-Agent: *" / "Allow: /" / "Disallow: /admin*/" / "Disallow: /pretraga/". Category pages and company pages are outside both Disallow prefixes; only the internal search must be avoided.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio. Parse company blocks straight off the listing page - name, address, phone(s) are all inline, so no detail-page fetch is needed for the phone. Optionally follow the company slug for a longer description. CORRECTED BY FUZZ-8: the earlier '~9-10 requests yields the whole source' is wrong, because the national pages truncate. Crawl the 9 category URLs AND iterate each over the geographic units in data/serbia-geo.json as <category>-<grad>: 9 categories x ~162 units = ~1,458 requests, about 25 minutes at 1 req/s. Two operational rules from the FUZZ-8 sweep: (1) 14 of 49 city slugs return a DETERMINISTIC HTTP 500 - beograd, pirot, kikinda, vrsac, ruma, backa-palanka, zajecar, paracin, aleksinac, cukarica, grocka, obrenovac, rakovica, sopot (retried twice each, not transient - a site defect, so treat 500 on a city slug as expected and keep going); (2) `beograd` itself is one of them, so iterate Belgrade through its 17 city municipalities instead - novi-beograd (15 firms), zemun (10), vozdovac (7), vracar (6), stari-grad (4) and surcin (4) all return 200. Dedup across city pages on normalized phone; overlap between national and city views is real.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium against gradjevinarstvo.rs and navidiku.rs (established Belgrade firms appear in all three). Dedup on normalized phone first - portal-srbija prints phones in a consistent 0XX/XXX-XXXX shape that normalizes cleanly.
sources.notes: Best phone-yield-per-request source found, by a wide margin. Caveat: sitemap <lastmod> values are all 2019-04-13, so a meaningful share of records is stale - expect dead numbers and treat last_seen_at carefully. /fasada is NOT a category, it is a single company named FASADA in Stara Pazova; the facade contractors live under termo-izolacija-zvucna-izolacija and zavrsni-radovi-restauracije. /stovarista returned 0 company links nationally while /stovarista-beograd returned 137 unique phones - the store side needs the city-scoped pages, and FUZZ-8 showed the contractor side does too. robots.txt permits the city-suffixed category pages: they are not under /pretraga/.

sources.name: Gradjevinarstvo.rs
sources.category: construction trade portal with company register
sources.estimate_method: Fetched https://gradjevinarstvo.rs/firme-sitemap (2.0 MB XML) and counted <loc> entries: exactly 11,291 company URLs. Facade-relevant slice sized from category pages: /kategorije/252/zastakljeni-zidovi-fasade = 20 firms, /kategorije/143/izolacija = 21 firms per page; the register spans the whole construction sector, so the facade-relevant subset must be recovered by keyword classification over the 11,291 pages rather than by category alone.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: ~90%. Sampled 10 company pages spread evenly across the sitemap (every 1200th entry): 9 of 10 carried at least one phone (1-4 numbers each); the only miss was /firme/3370/skupstina-opstine, a municipal body rather than a business. No usable mailto: - the only mailto: on the page is a share-by-email link.

pagination.how_addressed: Do not paginate the category UI - the company list is injected via /Kategorije/GetFirme/, which robots.txt disallows. Enumerate from https://gradjevinarstvo.rs/firme-sitemap instead, which lists all 11,291 /firme/{id}/{slug} URLs and is explicitly advertised in robots.txt via Sitemap:.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED for /firme/{id}/{slug}. https://www.gradjevinarstvo.rs/robots.txt disallows "/Kategorije/GetFirme/", "/FirmaDetaljiURL/", "/Pretraga/", "/firmadetalji.aspx*" and "/malioglasi/" - none of which match the canonical /firme/1015/mlaz path. The same file publishes "Sitemap: https://www.gradjevinarstvo.rs/sitemap_index.xml", which is the sanctioned enumeration route.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio + sitemap walk. GET /firme-sitemap once, then GET each /firme/{id}/{slug} page (11,291 requests - budget ~3 h at 1 req/s). Classify from the page's category tags and description text; keep FACADE_CONTRACTOR / CONSTRUCTION_MATERIAL_STORE, discard the rest. Store the numeric firm id as a stable source key.
sources.duplicate_risk: High against portal-srbija and navidiku for Belgrade/Novi Sad firms, and against the store registry (Bekament, Knauf Insulation, Baumit all have pages here). Dedup on normalized phone, then website domain.
sources.notes: Highest absolute volume of any allowed source. The cost is that it is sector-wide, not facade-specific, so classification quality decides the real yield - a rough read of the sampled pages suggests 8-12% are facade/insulation/finishing firms, i.e. roughly 900-1,350 usable contractor records. Verified phone example: /firme/5143/popovic shows 034 364 282 and 064 6409 640.

sources.name: Navidiku.rs - Baza firmi
sources.category: national business directory with per-city service categories
sources.estimate_method: Downloaded https://www.navidiku.rs/sitemap/sitemap-companies-001.xml.gz: 13,408 company URLs across 1,606 category-city segments. Counted companies whose URL segment matches a facade-relevant keyword (fasad|izolacij|moler|gradjevin|stovar|gips|adaptacij|izvodjenje-radova|zavrsn|termoizol|stiropor|krec): 68 segments, 330 companies. Largest: adaptacija-renoviranje-stana-beograd=38, molerski-radovi-beograd=32, gradjevinski-materijal-beograd=31, izvodjenje-radova-beograd=23, stovarista-beograd=21, gipsani-radovi-beograd=15, izolacija-beograd=13. This is a floor: the /firme/fasaderski-radovi/beograd filter view returned 10 firms that are filed under other primary segments.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: ~100%. Sampled 9 company pages spread across the sitemap: all 9 carried tel: links (3-14 per page). The /firme/fasaderski-radovi/beograd listing showed 9 tel: links across 10 result cards, with a 'Pozovi' button wired to e.g. tel:0615300597. Email is not exposed - 0 mailto: on every sampled page.

pagination.how_addressed: Listing pages state their own bounds ('Prikazano 1-10 od 10 rezultata'). For the facade slice pagination never triggers - every relevant category-city page fits on one page. Enumerate exhaustively from sitemap-companies-001.xml.gz rather than paging the UI.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://www.navidiku.rs/robots.txt "User-agent: *" block disallows only "/crm", "/video/admin", "/firme/assets", "/firme/ajax", "/firme/noviajax", "/gmap.php", "/fcache" and a few year-slugs. Company pages /firme/{kategorija-grad}/{firma} are allowed, and the file advertises "Sitemap: https://www.navidiku.rs/sitemap/sitemap-index.xml". Note: ClaudeBot has its own Disallow block - use an honest project-specific user agent, not a Claude UA.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio. Two modes, both cheap: (a) fetch the 68 relevant category-city listing pages and read name+address+phone straight off the cards; (b) fetch the 330 company pages for opening hours and full description. Avoid /firme/ajax entirely.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium-High against portal-srbija (both are Belgrade-heavy) and gradjevinarstvo.rs. Phone normalization dedups cleanly because navidiku emits raw digits in the tel: href.
sources.notes: Cleanest structured data of the three top sources: phone lives in a tel: href, so parsing is trivial and normalization is near-lossless. Volume in the facade slice is modest (330), but per-record quality is the best measured. /firme/fasaderski-radovi/nis and /firme/gradjevinski-materijal/beograd both 404 - the category-city pairs are not a full cross product, so drive the crawl off the sitemap, not off guessed URLs.

sources.name: Gradjevinske firme u Srbiji
sources.estimate_method: Site states '400 gradova i preko 3000 gradjevinskih firmi'. Verified the Belgrade branch by fetching /beograd/: 50 company detail links per page and pagination links up to /beograd/18, i.e. ~868 Belgrade firms (the homepage independently claims 868 for Beograd, 225 Novi Sad, 108 Nis - consistent with 50/page x 18). Scaling that ratio to the claimed national total gives ~3,000, which the per-city counters corroborate.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: High on detail pages, ~0% on listing pages. /beograd/ itself contains no phone; the detail page /beograd/012-prima-doo-beograd/ carries +381 11 3349 936. Homepage documents the record shape as 'Naziv preduzeca, adresa, telefon, web sajt, kratak opis delatnosti'.

pagination.how_addressed: /{grad}/ page 1, then /{grad}/2 ... /{grad}/18 - a bare integer path segment, 50 listings per page. City index at /svigradovi.

sources.robots_allows: NO robots.txt PUBLISHED. https://www.gradjevinskefirme.cu.rs/robots.txt returns HTTP 404 with an Apache error body. Absence of robots.txt means no crawl restrictions are expressed; crawl politely (>=1 s delay) and identify the bot honestly.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio, two-level walk: /svigradovi -> per-city paginated indexes -> ~3,000 detail pages. Budget ~3,100 requests. Phone must come from the detail page, so there is no listing-only shortcut here.
sources.duplicate_risk: High against gradjevinarstvo.rs - both are sector-wide construction registers with heavy Belgrade overlap. Dedup on phone, then on company name + city.
sources.notes: Old-school static site (DynamicDrive CSS menu, ~10 KB detail pages) - fast, cheap, no anti-bot. Same caveat as portal-srbija: no visible freshness signal, so a share of the 3,000 records will be stale. Sector-wide, so classification filtering is required; expect roughly 250-400 facade-relevant records.

sources.name: Poslovni Kontakt - Moleri, gipsari, fasaderi
sources.estimate_method: https://poslovnikontakt.com/ait-dir-item-sitemap.xml contains 746 <loc> entries (all directory items, all trades). Four facade/moler categories were confirmed present in ait-dir-item-category-sitemap.xml: /kategorija/molerski-fasaderski-gipsarski-radovi-srbija/ (10 shown at the default page size, with a Count selector offering 5/10/20/30/40/50/100), /kategorija/moleri-i-gipsari-beograd/, /kategorija/molerski-radovi-novi-sad-moleri/ and /kategorija/moleri-gipsari-fasaderi-loznica/.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: ~100% on the listing page itself. Every card renders one to three numbers inline, e.g. 'Moler Dragomir - 069 1484637, 064 1484637, 011 2778129' and 'Moler Dragan - 064 0 666 219'. Address and email are largely absent - this is a phone-first directory, which is exactly the ranking criterion.

pagination.how_addressed: AIT directory Count parameter: request the category with the page size set to 100 to collapse the category into a single response, then follow the numbered pager if the category exceeds 100.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED, unrestricted. https://poslovnikontakt.com/robots.txt: "User-agent: *" / "Disallow:" (empty Disallow = allow everything) plus "Sitemap: https://poslovnikontakt.com/sitemap_index.xml".
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio. Pull ait-dir-item-category-sitemap.xml, keep the four facade/moler categories (plus gradjevinarstvo-i-zanastvo for spillover), fetch each with a large page size, and read name + contact person + phones off the cards. Under 20 requests for the whole facade slice.
sources.duplicate_risk: Low. Skews to individual preduzetnici and small moler/fasader crews that do not appear in the corporate registers. This is the least-overlapping High source.
sources.notes: Small in absolute terms but the highest phone-density-per-listing of anything measured, and it reaches exactly the buyer profile the product targets: sole-trader fasaderi with a mobile number and no company website. Because these are preduzetnici, the ZZPL personal-data handling in the project brief applies most sharply here.

sources.name: 011info - Beogradski informator
sources.estimate_method: Category pages are small but numerous: /izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija shows 2 firms on page 1 of 2. The construction hub /gradjevinarstvo links 67 subcategories, of which the relevant ones are izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija, gradjevinski-materijal, stovarista, stovarista-ogreva and gradjevinske-firme-usluge. Estimating ~20-40 firms per relevant subcategory across those 5 plus their pagination gives roughly 150-400 Belgrade records; 400 is the optimistic bound and should be re-measured before committing crawler budget.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: 0% on listing cards, high on detail pages. /izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija shows only name + address + blurb; the detail page /izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija/bimax-doo contains 6 distinct numbers.

pagination.how_addressed: Numbered pager on each subcategory page ('1 2'). Detail URL is /{subcategory-slug}/{company-slug}. The site-wide sitemap at /sitemap.xml is advertised in robots.txt and is the better enumeration route.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://www.011info.com/robots.txt: "User-agent: *" / "Allow: /" / "Sitemap: https://www.011info.com/sitemap.xml". No Disallow rules at all.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio for category and detail pages (both render server-side). The /pretraga?q= endpoint returns navigation only - results are loaded client-side - so do not build on site search; walk /sitemap.xml or the 5 relevant subcategory slugs instead. Phone requires the detail-page fetch.
sources.duplicate_risk: High against portal-srbija and navidiku - all three are Belgrade-dominant. 011info is worth keeping mainly as a phone-completion source for firms already discovered elsewhere.
sources.notes: Belgrade only, and there is no facade-specific subcategory - the closest is izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija. Ranked High on phone quality per detail page and a fully permissive robots.txt, not on volume. Verify the real category sizes before allocating crawler time; the estimate above is the weakest number in this registry.

sources.name: Goglasi.com - Gradjevinske usluge i majstori
sources.estimate_method: Category page states '1-25 od 12033 rezultata' - 12,033 ads at 25 per page = 482 pages. Facade-specific subsets via ?q=: 'Potrebni fasaderi' and 'izrada fasada' both return live result sets.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: 0% on Goglasi itself. Result cards carry no phone; Goglasi links out to the originating site (netoglasi.net, netoglasi.rs, lalafo.rs and others), where the number lives. Effective phone yield therefore depends entirely on the downstream site.

pagination.how_addressed: /usluge/gradjevinske-usluge-i-majstori/search?categoryId=281&start=N with N incrementing by 25.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://www.goglasi.com/robots.txt: "User-agent: *" with "Allow: /" and Disallows limited to /generror.aspx, /Error.htm, /url, /suggest, /frame, /cdn-cgi/, /ct. Separately "User-agent: ClaudeBot" / "Crawl-delay: 1" and "User-agent: meta-externalagent" / "Disallow: /".
sources.recommended_approach: Use as a discovery layer, not a record source: crawl the category with the facade query terms, harvest the outbound target URLs, and group them by destination domain to find classified sites we have not registered yet. Do not build lead records from Goglasi rows.
sources.duplicate_risk: Very high by construction - it aggregates other sites, so every record is a duplicate of something. Only ever store the resolved destination record.
sources.notes: Best use is source discovery: it surfaced netoglasi.net, netoglasi.rs and lalafo.rs as ad destinations that none of our directory searches reached. Cheap to run, near-zero direct phone value.

sources.name: Oglasi.rs - Usluge
sources.estimate_method: ?q=fasaderski inside /oglasi/usluge returns 13 matching ads. Broader terms (fasada, demit, termoizolacija) will lift this, but the category is small relative to KupujemProdajem - the whole Usluge category page rendered 34 distinct numbers.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: Moderate, body-text only. Result cards do not carry a phone; the number appears inside the ad description on the detail page, e.g. 'Tel 064 27 80 677'. Expect 50-70% of tradesman ads to embed a number in free text.

pagination.how_addressed: /oglasi/usluge?q=<term>&p=<n>. Ad detail URLs are /oglas/03-2758232/<slug>.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED for the category path. https://www.oglasi.rs/robots.txt: "User-agent: *" / "Disallow: /oglasi?q=*" / "Disallow: /oglasi?o=*" / "Disallow: /korisnici/moj-nalog*". The disallow is the literal prefix /oglasi?q= ; our path /oglasi/usluge?q=fasaderski does not begin with it and is therefore permitted. Do not hit the bare /oglasi?q= form.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio. Run each Serbian facade term against /oglasi/usluge?q=, page with &p=, fetch each /oglas/ detail page and regex the phone out of the description body. Keep the raw string per the project's phone rules.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium against KupujemProdajem and Goglasi - the same crews cross-post. Dedup on normalized phone.
sources.notes: Small but legitimately crawlable, and the phone is in plain text rather than behind a click-gate - which is what makes it usable where KupujemProdajem is not. Ranked Medium purely on volume.

sources.name: Zute strane - Fasade i izolacija
sources.estimate_method: Direct count on the category page: 5 companies rendered, no pagination controls. 7 unique phone-shaped strings in the page HTML.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: ~100% of the 5 listings, e.g. Fermax - 'Telefon (01112345xx): 0113118085'.

pagination.how_addressed: Single page for this category.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://zutestrane.net/robots.txt: "User-agent: *" / "Disallow: /wp-admin/" / "Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" plus a second block disallowing one wp-content JSON file. No restriction on /firme/.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio, single fetch of the category page plus 5 detail pages. Not worth a dedicated adapter on its own - fold it into a small generic WordPress-directory adapter shared with poslovnikontakt.
sources.duplicate_risk: Low at this size, but PIB and maticni broj are exposed, which makes it valuable as a company-identity enrichment source for leads found elsewhere.
sources.notes: Tiny, but the only source measured that publishes PIB and maticni broj alongside the phone. Ranked Medium for that enrichment value, not for volume.

sources.name: PTT Imenik Srbije
sources.estimate_method: Fetched all 16 sitemap pages (https://www.pttimenik.com/sitemap.xml?page=1..16): 31,608 URLs total. Keyword counts across that set: fasad=6, izolacij=6, moler=12, stiropor=2 - versus stovarist=643 and gradjevinsk=280. The facade contractor slice is genuinely 6 URLs; /demit-fasade lists 2 companies.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: High on detail pages - /demit-fasade-beograd/farbara-hemoluks-demit-fasada carries 011 993698 and mailto:hemoluks@beotel.rs. 0% on the category listing page.

pagination.how_addressed: Category is /{kategorija} nationally and /{kategorija}-{grad} per city; detail is /{kategorija}-{grad}/{firma}. Enumerate from sitemap.xml?page=1..16 (2,000 URLs per page).

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. https://www.pttimenik.com/robots.txt is the stock Drupal file: "User-agent: *" with Allow rules for CSS/JS/images and Disallow rules confined to Drupal internals (/core/, /includes/, /admin/, node edit paths). Nothing blocks category or company pages.

sources.name: Daibau.rs - Imenik fasaderi
sources.estimate_method: SUPERSEDES the FUZZ-4 estimate of 75. Re-measured 2026-08-21 (FUZZ-39) by walking /imenik/fasade/beograd?page=1..54 to exhaustion: 51 populated pages x 15 cards, 748 unique /izvodjac/ slugs (pages 52-54 return zero cards). The FUZZ-4 figure of ~75 came from reading the on-page pager, which only ever links page N+1 and so never reveals the depth. The listing is NATIONAL and distance-ranked rather than city-scoped - page 1 is 3-12 km from the anchor city, page 20 is 15-27 km, page 40 is 63-98 km (Kragujevac, Kraljevo, Backa Palanka) - so a 'city' URL is a ranking origin, not a filter. One anchor does not cover the country: page 1 alone of vranje, subotica, novi_pazar, zajecar and sombor adds 12, 13, 13, 11 and 14 contractors respectively that the 748-record Belgrade sweep never reached, so the true national total is plausibly 1,200-1,800. sitemap_craftsmen.xml holds 16,925 /izvodjac/ profiles across all trades; sitemap_directory1..6 hold 252,545 /imenik/<category>/<city> URLs, which is a generated 265 x 953 cartesian matrix, not an index.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: 0% obtainable - CONFIRMED by direct measurement 2026-08-21 (FUZZ-39). 59 listing pages were scanned (fasade/beograd 1-54, 12 adjacent categories, 5 far-anchor cities): 108 href="tel:" links, exactly 2 distinct numbers, 0 of them a contractor. The two are +381 11 418 26 07 and +381 66 510 7 644, daibau's own switchboard, rendered site-wide in the footer help popup div.popup3#contacts under the labels 'Potraznje:' and 'Preduzeca:' - they appear twice on every page of the site whatever it lists (54 pages x 2 = 108). All 7 /izvodjac/ profiles sampled render the contractor phone TRUNCATED to a 7-digit prefix in div#phoneNumToClick, e.g. '0603460...klik' - 2-3 digits short of a Serbian mobile, so 100-1000 candidates and not a usable number. The full value comes from /autosecretary/getPhoneNumber/, the FIRST Disallow line in robots.txt; the visible 'Tel:' link points at /izvodjac/<slug>/posalji_narudzbu, also disallowed via '*posalji_narudzbu*'. Profile pages additionally load Cloudflare Turnstile and fingerprint2.min.js, so the reveal is CAPTCHA- and fingerprint-gated on top of the robots ban. The endpoint was not called. Profiles also publish no mailto:, no contractor website and no social profile - the only external links are daibau's sister sites emajstor.hr and mojmojster.net - so email coverage and website coverage are 0% as well.

pagination.how_addressed: ?page=N, 15 cards per page, container div.listbox.crli. The pager publishes no total and only ever links N+1, so the end is found by walking until a page yields zero cards. Corrects the FUZZ-4 reading of 'a 5-page pager'.

sources.robots_allows: PARTIALLY - and the disallowed part is exactly the part we need. https://www.daibau.rs/robots.txt: "User-Agent: *" / "Disallow: /autosecretary/getPhoneNumber/" (first rule in the file), plus /iskanje/, /references/showListCategoried/, /projektanti-izvajalci/ and ~90 named bots blocked wholesale including wget and HTTrack. Listing and profile pages are allowed; the phone endpoint is not.
sources.recommended_approach: DO NOT BUILD AN ADAPTER. Unchanged in substance from FUZZ-4, now backed by a full sweep (FUZZ-39): the only path to a contractor number is the robots-disallowed, CAPTCHA-gated /autosecretary/getPhoneNumber/, and taking it would breach robots.txt and the project's compliance rules. A paid unblocker does not change this - it defeats Cloudflare, not a robots.txt Disallow. Taken as names only the source is 748+ facade contractors with a name and a city and no phone, email or website; measured against the 3,601-lead pilot database with the project's own normalizeCompanyName, only 12 (1.6%) already exist, so they cannot even be used to upgrade the classification of leads that already carry a phone. If the names are wanted as a target list for sources that do publish phones, or to resolve against APR, that is a separate issue and must not write uncontactable rows into `leads`. Listings themselves are plain server-rendered HTML and need no JavaScript - cheerio would have been sufficient, which is why requires_js is now false: the JS requirement applies to the phone reveal only.
sources.duplicate_risk: Low, measured. 12 of 748 names (1.6%) match the pilot database exactly under normalizeCompanyName; 7 more clear normalizedNameSimilarity 0.82 and most of those are spurious ('rading' vs 'grading', 'zemun gradnja' vs 'zemun'). Supersedes the FUZZ-4 guess of Medium.
sources.notes: The most disappointing result of this pass. On the surface Daibau is the ideal source - a facade-named directory, well populated, city-segmented, top of every Serbian search result. In practice the phone is deliberately gated behind an endpoint their robots.txt names first, because lead-routing is their business model. Under the project's phone-first ranking that makes it Low regardless of how good the listings look. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-21 by FUZZ-39, which had been opened on reconnaissance that read daibau's two footer switchboard numbers as contractor phones and promoted the source to 'highest-yield of the four new sources'. It is not: two numbers on a page of fifteen contractors, identical on every page of the site. FUZZ-39 was closed without an adapter, per the disposal rule stated in FUZZ-40 - a source that yields names and no numbers is not worth an adapter. Full write-up with the measurements: research/2026-08-21-fuzz-39-daibau-rs.md.

sources.estimate_method: CORRECTED BY FUZZ-40 from a full crawl, not an estimate: 56 under `fasader` and 33 under `izolater`, 89 profiles, all of them walked. Two adjacent-category facts matter. Contact does not run through a form.

Facade- and store-relevant subsets by registered activity code: 4331 Malterisanje 100, 4334 Bojenje i zastakljivanje 155, 4339 Ostali zavrsni radovi 564, 4329 Ostali instalacioni radovi u gradjevinarstvu 266, 4673 Veleprodaja drveta/gradj. materijala/sanitarije 1,119, 4752 Maloprodaja metalne robe, boja i stakla 609 - core six = 2,813 across 168 municipalities. pagination.how_addressed: One request returns the whole 57.7 MB document. Refresh monthly and diff against the stored snapshot.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED. openapi.apr.gov.rs publishes no robots.txt, and this endpoint is the documented, advertised open-data delivery channel, listed on the Serbian national open-data portal data.gov.rs as dataset 'api-za-registar-privrednikh-drushtava'. Licence: sodl (Serbian Open Data Licence). The Disallow: / on the separate apr.gov.rs / pretraga2.apr.gov.rs search UI governs that UI, not this API.
sources.recommended_approach: Fetch once per month, store the snapshot, and use it as a frame rather than as leads. Three uses: (1) coverage measurement - 'we hold a phone number for N of the 2,813 companies registered under the core codes in municipality X' is the only real coverage statistic this project can produce; (2) classification ground truth - the registered activity code is the state's own FACADE_CONTRACTOR vs CONSTRUCTION_MATERIAL_STORE call, so matching a scraped lead on name + city beats guessing from description text; (3) targeted enrichment - frame companies with no phone yet form a ranked worklist ordered by municipality. Free, so no cost approval is needed.
sources.duplicate_risk: Not a lead source, so it never inserts leads and never causes duplicates. It joins to existing leads on legal name + municipality; maticni broj is the stable key once a lead has one. Name matching against scraped trade names needs ASCII folding and legal-form stripping (d.o.o., DOO, PR) before it will match.
sources.notes: Found by FUZZ-8; it reopens the source FUZZ-4 had to reject. Priority Low is the phone-first rule applied honestly (zero phones), NOT a judgement on value - as a coverage frame and a classifier oracle it is High. The hard limitation: this dataset covers privredna drustva only (DOO, AD). It does NOT cover preduzetnici, the sole traders that the project brief names as a large share of Serbian fasaderi. /api/opendata/entrepreneurs and /api/opendata/preduzetnici were both probed and both return 404, and data.gov.rs holds no preduzetnici dataset. sources.phone_coverage_estimate: MEASURED 63.9% by FUZZ-45 on a real 2,000-record sample (400 per core code, modern surface, 2026-08-22): 1,278 records with a phone. Per code: 43.31 75%, 43.34 73%, 43.39 65%, 43.99 56%, 43.29 51%. That is a little below FUZZ-41's 68% (which sampled 75 records) and it holds up across all five codes. Maticni broj 99.3%, PIB 74.6%, municipality resolved 94.4%. WEBSITE IS 0.2% (4 records in 2,320) - FUZZ-41's warning about the 'Sajt:' prose trap is confirmed from the other side: the field really is empty on almost every record, and a parser that reports 67% is reading the sentence underneath it. Phones render as +381.(0)64.4320025, also +381 (0)62 629230 and +381.(063)7193382, comma-separated when multiple; src/lib/phone parses all three shapes unchanged.

pagination.how_addressed: None. Every record in a category is rendered on one static page - /Srbija/l70_Malterisanje.html is 138,625 bytes with all 900 detail links. Two surfaces exist: modern /Srbija/<slug>/<id> (full street address, 4-digit sifra delatnosti) and legacy /preduzetnici/p<id>_<slug>.htm reached via /preduzetnici/preduzetnici.php?delatnost=<6-digit code> (street name only, 6-digit code). sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED, by absence of any rule. https://www.kompanije.net/robots.txt (HTTP 200) contains ONLY the Cloudflare content-signals comment header - no User-agent line, no Disallow, and no content-signal values set. Nothing is restricted and nothing is granted by signal.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio, no JS. Two requests per record is the floor: one category page (gives every detail URL) plus one detail page each. ~9,830 core contractor records + ~4,577 store records = ~14,400 detail fetches, about 4 hours at 1 req/s. Anchors use SINGLE quotes (href='./slug/12345') - a double-quote-only href regex silently matches nothing. The detail page is a label/value list; read the line after the exact label text 'Telefon:', 'Adresa:', 'Matični broj:', 'PIB:'. Guard against the empty case: when a field is blank the next line is the FOLLOWING LABEL, so reject any value ending in ':'. The 'Sajt:' label is followed by a prose sentence rather than the next label, which makes a naive parser report a website on every record - it reported 67% before the bug was caught, and the true website coverage is near zero.
sources.duplicate_risk: MEASURED by FUZZ-45 on the 2,320-record sample, and lower than FUZZ-41 feared on both sides. Against apr-opendata: 329 of 2,302 distinct maticni brojevi (14.3%) are in the open data - the ceiling is the 28% of records that are companies at all, since APR open data excludes preduzetnici. It costs nothing either way: apr-opendata carries no phone, so a match adds a registered name and municipality to a lead this source already brought a number for. On 52 of those 329 APR's registered activity code disagrees with the category the record was found in. Against the directories already harvested: 1.2%. Scored with the project's own findCandidates + scoreMatch against a 3,024-lead corpus of overture-places, gradjevinarstvo-rs, portal-srbija and austrotherm-distributeri - 27 of 2,320 merged (13 decided on phone, 14 on name+city), 82 in the review band, 2,211 new (95.3%). That is the register-versus-marketing split showing up as a number. Dedup on maticni broj first here, not phone: this source exposes it on 99.3% of records and src/lib/dedup already weights registrationNumber at 0.98.
sources.priority_reason: CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT (FUZZ-45). ~9,830 core-code records at a measured 63.9% phone fill is ~6,280 phone-bearing facade records for 0 RSD, and 95.3% of them were new against the existing corpus. 71.9% are preduzetnici - the population the repo calls its largest structural coverage gap and the one APR open data cannot reach at all. The counterweight is freshness: 54.3% of the company subset is deregistered or in liquidation, so this is a first-call-verification source, not a registrar-grade one.
open_questions_before_relying_on_it: ANSWERED by FUZZ-45 for companies, still open for sole traders: the dead-record rate is 54.3% on the 28% of records carrying a company maticni broj (321 of 650 struck off, 32 in liquidation or bankruptcy). No free register-grade check exists for the other 72%, the preduzetnici - that is precisely what an APR purchase would provide. See the freshness field.
The site invites visitors to edit a company's own record ('Izmeni podatke'), so a phone may be user-submitted rather than register-derived. Treat every number as needing first-call verification.
Phone format +381.(0)NN.NNNNNN suggests a bulk telephone-directory join rather than APR's registered kontakt podaci. Provenance of the phone field is unconfirmed.

The legacy /preduzetnici/ surface (8,001 records across the five core codes) is implemented and opt-in but UNMEASURED. Its detail markup is identical to the modern one, so it costs nothing to support; what it ADDS is unknown, because settling that needs a maticni-broj join and therefore a second ~8,000-request crawl. A 40-character name-prefix comparison on 43.31 leaves 306 of 852 (36%) unmatched, but the two surfaces order a personal name differently, so 36% is a ceiling and not a measurement.
sources.compliance_notes: Public business-contact data, no login, no CAPTCHA, no rule in robots.txt to respect or breach. Rate-limit to <=1 req/s and identify the crawler honestly - unlike pretraga.apr.gov.rs, this host does not block an honest User-Agent.
sources.tos_forbids: NO - and this was checked rather than assumed. There are no terms of service on the site at all: the footer carries region links (Srbija / Hrvatska / Bosna i Hercegovina / Republika Srpska / Kosovo i Metohija) and a kontakt.php form, and no uslovi, pravila, impressum or privacy page exists anywhere on it. Verified 2026-08-21 by FUZZ-44 during the ToS sweep that closed daibau.rs (Clan 6, non-commercial use only) and companywall.rs (explicit anti-scraping clause). Re-confirmed 2026-08-21 by FUZZ-45 when the adapter was built. With robots.txt carrying no rule and no contract to breach, the remaining constraints are the ordinary ones: politeness, an honest User-Agent, and ZZPL - most records are preduzetnici, so a business phone here is personal data and only business-contact data the business itself published is collected.
sources.adapter: src/scraper/sources/kompanije-net (FUZZ-45). Modern surface by default (five core codes, ~9,830 records, needs --budget 12000 to clear in one run); --query legacy adds the sole-trader index; --query <code|sifra|listId> selects an adjacent activity code. Numbers re-derivable with scripts/fuzz45-overlap.ts.
sources.freshness: MEASURED, and it is the main risk: 54.3% of the company records are dead. FUZZ-45 joined the sample to APR open data (cut 2026-07-31) on maticni broj. Of the 650 sampled records carrying a COMPANY registration number, 297 are still Aktivan, 32 are in liquidation or bankruptcy, and 321 have been struck off the register entirely. AGMAX DOO BEOGRAD (CUKARICA) is listed on kompanije.net as 'Aktivno privredno drustvo' and does not appear in APR's register at all. Two limits, both load-bearing. (1) It covers the 28% of records that are companies; the 72% that are sole traders cannot be checked against any free register, which is exactly what an APR purchase would buy. (2) 'Dead' means deregistered, not unreachable - a struck-off company's owner often still answers the phone as a preduzetnik. Treat 54% as a warning about export quality, not as a discard rule. The company/sole-trader split is read off the registration number, not off the page: all 133,634 maticni brojevi in APR open data begin 0, 1 or 2 and a preduzetnik's begins 5 or 6, while the page's own 'Forma:' field appeared on only 92 of the 650 company-number records. Re-derive with scripts/fuzz45-overlap.ts.
sources.adjacent_codes_verdict: DECIDED by FUZZ-45 on an 80-record sample of each, as the issue asked. The measure is the share of records whose REGISTERED NAME names a facade trade (fasad, termoizolac, stiropor, demit, izolacij, malteris) - a floor rather than a rate, since a sole trader called 'SZR MILAN' reveals nothing, but measured identically for all nine codes so they are comparable. CRAWL 43.91 Krovni radovi: 8% facade-named, above two of the five core codes (43.39 and 43.99 both come in at 2%), 329 records, about eight minutes. SKIP 43.32 Ugradnja stolarije (1%), 43.33 Postavljanje podnih i zidnih obloga (0%) and 41.20 Izgradnja stambenih i nestambenih zgrada (0% facade-named across 80 records, 5,663 records of it at 51% phone fill) - exactly the noise FUZZ-45 predicted for 41.20. 43.91 is NOT promoted to the adapter's core tier, because core also means claiming assertedType: FACADE_CONTRACTOR and 92% of 43.91 is roofing; it is opt-in with --query 43.91 and left for src/lib/classify to judge. Core-code facade-named shares for comparison: 43.31 13%, 43.34 10%, 43.29 5%, 43.39 2%, 43.99 2%.
